# Bid the duct and the fan, not the hood count.

> Price a restaurant hood and exhaust cleaning from the system — canopy, filters, duct, and rooftop fan — plus grease load, after-hours access, and the walk-away number. Not a per-hood guess.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
